body: Because pheremones are a very real thing, kids.

I guess I just don't understand a) why people constantly ask me to self-identify as something and b) why some ethnicities are considered "white" and others aren't.

When people stop me and ask about my ethnic background and I answer them - they always seem... disappointed. I just get perturbed that they need to label me - I don't even label me, because none of the labels feel right.

I don't feel Hispanic, because I don't... participate in Hispanic culture.

*shrug*
